Definition: from G2295; to wonder; by implication, to admire:--admire, have in admiration, marvel, wonder.
BiblicalUsage: thaumázō stands behind the English phrase to wonder, to marvel. In Matthew 8:10, he marvelled, and said to them that followed, and it appears again in Mark 5:20.
TheologicalSignificance: Jesus marvelling at a centurion's faith makes me want a trust in Him that surprises even heaven.
